title: Convert the worktree merge door from verify run to proof check
action: In the worktree merge path, retire the verify child and check proof via td-2's shared helper (verbs/cells/proof.rs — reuse, never duplicate). The symbols live in merge.rs, not phases.rs: run_verify_child and VerifyOutcome are defined at merge.rs (~837, 860, 931) and the skip message "verify skipped — no commands.test recorded; cleaned up unchecked." at merge.rs (~673); phases.rs only calls them (~734) and builds VerifyOutcome{ran:false} (~716); the verify_command derivation with its "none"-sentinel filter sits in handlers.rs (~530). Stop spawning the command; call the proof helper over the merging feature's capped cells — resolve the cells-store root the same way the merge path's existing store reads do (merge runs from MAIN against the feature's records; per plan, follow the scribing-debt sibling's root resolution). Refusal names the proof-less cell and the remedy; legacy report-less caps pass with the named note. Reshape or rename VerifyOutcome bookkeeping (ran:true/false) to record the proof-check outcome honestly. Do not touch --skip-uat or the UAT gate. Update the worktree-merge help row in generated/registry_payload.json (it still promises commands.test runs against the merged tree). Repoint the worktree suite assertions pinning the verify-child; cover the triad: fully-proofed merge proceeds; present-but-empty proof refuses naming the cell; legacy cap passes with note; refusal never silent.

merge of a fully-proofed feature proceeds to the normal merge finish
merge with a present-but-empty proof refuses, naming the cell; a report-less legacy cap passes with a named note
